title: Push notifications
enable: Turn on push notifications to the Companion app
defaultOff: The switch is off on every fresh install and after every update. While it is off, this server makes no contact with the relay at all.

explanation.operator: The relay push.travstats.de is run by the TravStats project. It forwards notifications to Apple and Google.
explanation.receives: Per message it receives the phone's push token and the end-to-end-encrypted content. Neither the relay nor Cloudflare, Apple or Google can read the content. In transit it also sees this server's IP address.
explanation.stores: It stores only an instance ID, a hash of its secret and a daily counter.

relayUrlHint: https:// only (or http://localhost for testing). With a different address this server registers anew.
notRegisteredHint: Registration happens automatically with the first notification once you have switched push on.
resetDone: Registration reset. This server registers anew with the next push.
pausedUntil: Paused until {{time}} (the relay's daily limit was reached)
loadFailed: The push settings could not be loaded.
saveFailed: The push settings could not be saved.
invalidUrl: Invalid address. Only https:// (or http://localhost) is allowed.
